u1-t03.caption: Population versus Sample: Extracting a representative random sample (statistic) from a biological population (parameter).

u1-t04.caption: Graphical Representation of Data: Histogram and frequency distribution curve of continuous variables.

u1-t06.caption: Measures of Dispersion: Standard Deviation (σ) bands and cumulative dispersion around the population mean.

u1-t07.caption: Standard Error of the Mean (SEM) & Coefficient of Variation: Convergence of sample mean distributions toward a normal curve as sample size (n) increases.

u1-t09.caption: Elementary Probability Theory: Sample space, intersection (A ∩ B), union (A ∪ B), and conditional probability relationships.

u1-t10.caption: Binomial & Poisson Probability Distributions: Discrete probability mass function (PMF) across varying parameters (n, p).

u1-t11.caption: Normal (Gaussian) Distribution: Bell-shaped probability density curve showing empirical ±1σ (68.27%), ±2σ (95.45%), and ±3σ (99.73%) intervals.

u1-t12.caption: Correlation Analysis: Scatter diagrams illustrating strength and direction of Pearson's linear correlation coefficient (r).

u1-t13.caption: Linear Regression Analysis: Least-squares regression line (Y = a + bX) fitted to bivariate observations.

u1-t14.caption: Sampling Methods: Stratified and random sampling partitioning a heterogeneous population into homogeneous strata.

u1-t15.caption: Large Sample Z-Test & Hypothesis Testing: Standard normal critical rejection regions and p-value thresholds.

u1-t16.caption: Small Sample Student's t-Test: Family of t-distribution curves across degrees of freedom (ν) approaching the standard normal curve.

u1-t17.caption: Chi-Square (χ²) Test of Significance: Probability density curves across degrees of freedom for Goodness of Fit and Independence.

u1-t19.caption: Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) & F-Test: Snedecor's F-distribution curves comparing between-group to within-group variance.

u1-t20.caption: Non-Parametric Statistical Tests: Distribution-free cumulative empirical comparison for rank and ordinal biological data.

u1-t22.caption: Veterinary Data Analysis using Spreadsheets: Automated tabular cells, statistical formulas, and graphical chart generation.

u2-t01.caption: History of Animal Genetics: Gregor Johann Mendel and the foundational laws of particulate inheritance.

u2-t02.caption: Cell Division (Mitosis vs. Meiosis): Chromosomal replication, homologous pairing, crossing over, and reductional division.

u2-t03.caption: Chromosome Morphology & Classification: Structural organization of chromatids, centromere constriction, and telomeres.

u2-t04.caption: Mendelian Principles: Segregation of alleles and independent assortment illustrated by Mendelian cross diagrams.

u2-t05.caption: Modified Mendelian Inheritance: Autosomal dominance, incomplete dominance, and codominant allele expression.

u2-t06.caption: Epistasis & Gene Interactions: Non-allelic interaction modifying classical dihybrid ratios (e.g., coat colour inheritance).

u2-t07.caption: Pleiotropy, Penetrance & Expressivity: Genotype-to-phenotype mapping where single loci affect multiple biological traits.

u2-t08.caption: Multiple Alleles & Blood Group Systems: Co-dominant and multi-allelic cell-surface antigen inheritance.

u2-t09.caption: Chromosomal Sex Determination Mechanisms: Comparative XX/XY (mammalian) and ZZ/ZW (avian) chromosomal systems.

u2-t11.caption: Genetic Linkage & Crossing Over: Chiasma formation and reciprocal exchange of chromatid segments during pachytene.

u2-t12.caption: Gene Mutations: Molecular mechanisms of base substitution (transition, transversion) and frameshift mutations.

u2-t13.caption: Chromosomal Aberrations: Structural chromosome mutations — Deletion, Duplication, Inversion, and Translocation.

u2-t14.caption: Cytogenetics & Karyotyping: G-banded metaphase chromosome idiogram arranged by size and centromere position.

u2-t15.caption: Extra-Chromosomal (Mitochondrial) Inheritance: Circular maternal mtDNA genome encoding oxidative phosphorylation genes.

u2-t16.caption: Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: Watson-Crick DNA double helix showing sugar-phosphate backbone and complementary base pairs.

u2-t17.caption: DNA Replication & Central Dogma: Semiconservative replication fork with leading and lagging strands, helicase, and DNA polymerase.

u2-t18.caption: Molecular Techniques (PCR, RFLP, Sequencing): Exponential amplification of target DNA via thermal cycling.

u2-t21.caption: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium Law: Parabolic relationship between allele frequencies (p, q) and genotype frequencies (p², 2pq, q²).

u2-t26.caption: Genotype × Environment (G × E) Interaction: Reaction norms illustrating differential phenotypic expression across environments.

u2-t29.caption: Genetic & Phenotypic Correlations: Bivariate association and correlated response between quantitative traits.

u3-t01.caption: History of Animal Breeding: Artificial selection and domestication transforming ancestral wild types into specialized breeds.

u3-t02.caption: Classification of Livestock Breeds: Indigenous humped Zebu cattle (Bos indicus) adapted to tropical climates.

u3-t03.caption: Economic Traits of Dairy Livestock: Mammary conformation and 305-day lactation production characteristics.

u3-t05.caption: Bases of Selection: Standard pedigree chart tracking ancestral and collateral performance across generations.

u3-t06.caption: Combined & Indirect Selection: Combining individual and family genetic information to maximize selection accuracy.

u3-t07.caption: Methods of Selection: Truncation selection threshold retaining elite breeding individuals above the culling point.

u3-t08.caption: Classification of Mating Systems: Genetic pairing schemas comparing random panmixia and targeted assortative matings.

u3-t13.caption: Selection for Combining Ability (RRS): Reciprocal recurrent hybridization maximizing specific combining ability.

u3-t14.caption: Breeding Strategies for Dairy Cattle: Indigenous Sahiwal dairy cattle — premier milch zebu breed of India.

u3-t15.caption: Breeding Strategies for Sheep, Goats & Swine: Indigenous Jamnapari goat breed utilized in meat and milk improvement.

u3-t16.caption: Commercial Poultry Breeding: White Leghorn strain selected for high egg production and feed efficiency.

u3-t17.caption: Sire Evaluation & Progeny Testing (BLUP): Elite dairy genetics evaluated across contemporary herd-year-season groups.

u3-t19.caption: Development of New Breeds & Synthetic Strains: Indigenous Gir cattle genetics used in synthetic crossbred strains.

u3-t20.caption: National Livestock Breeding Policies in India: Elite Murrah riverine buffalo — cornerstone of Indian dairy improvement.

u3-t21.caption: Conservation of Animal Genetic Resources (AnGR): Ex-situ cryoconservation in liquid nitrogen gene banks (-196°C).

u3-t22.caption: Reproductive Biotechnologies (AI, MOET, IVF): Artificial insemination and assisted reproductive technology in cattle.

u3-t23.caption: Breeding for Disease Resistance: MHC (BoLA) molecular structure mediating genetic resistance to pathogens.

u3-t24.caption: Dog & Cat Breeds and Conformation Standards: Working dog anatomical conformation and breed standard morphology.

u3-t26.caption: Common Pet Birds & Avian Breeding Management: Captive breeding and colour genetics in Budgerigars.

u3-t28.caption: Planned Wildlife Breeding & Conservation: Captive breeding and reintroduction programme for endangered species.

u1-t01.caption: Biostatistical Analysis Framework: Visual summary of descriptive and inferential statistical distributions in biological sciences.

u1-t02.caption: Tabulation & Frequency Distribution: Grouped class intervals and frequency distribution of continuous measurements.

u1-t05.caption: Measures of Central Tendency: Geometric position of Mode, Median, and Arithmetic Mean across skewed and symmetric curves.

u1-t08.caption: Moments, Skewness & Kurtosis: Asymmetry (positive vs. negative skewness) and peakedness in probability distributions.

u1-t18.caption: Experimental Designs (CRD & RBD): Controlling nuisance environmental gradients through blocking and randomization.

u1-t21.caption: Database Management Systems (DBMS): Relational table structure with primary keys, records (rows), and attributes (columns).

u2-t10.caption: Sex-Linked Inheritance: Criss-cross transmission of X-linked alleles from carrier dams to affected male progeny.

u2-t19.caption: Population Genetics Foundations: Distribution and transmission of alleles across segregating loci in a population.

u2-t20.caption: Genetic Structure of a Population: Genotypic values and allele frequency distribution across a diploid locus.

u2-t22.caption: Forces Changing Gene Frequency: Stochastic allele frequency fluctuations (Genetic Drift) in small vs. large populations.

u2-t23.caption: Quantitative vs. Qualitative Genetics: Continuous polygenic inheritance and genome-wide QTL distribution across multiple additive loci.

u2-t24.caption: Average Effect of Gene & Breeding Value: Partitioning genotypic values into linear additive effects (BV) and dominance deviations.

u2-t25.caption: Components of Phenotypic Variance: Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL) mapping and partitioning of genetic variance.

u2-t27.caption: Heritability (h²) & Selection Response: Relationship between narrow-sense heritability (slope) and genetic gain (R = h²S).

u2-t28.caption: Repeatability (r): Intraclass correlation measuring consistency of repeated longitudinal measurements on the same animal.

u3-t04.caption: Selection in Animal Breeding: Directional, Stabilizing, and Disruptive selection shifting population genetic mean.

u3-t09.caption: Inbreeding Coefficient (FX) & Relationship (RXY): Pedigree path loop showing identity by descent (IBD) from common ancestors.

u3-t10.caption: Inbreeding Depression: Fitness and performance decline resulting from increased homozygosity of deleterious recessives.

u3-t11.caption: Outbreeding & Crossbreeding Systems: Grading up and backcrossing schema progressively replacing indigenous genes.

u3-t12.caption: Heterosis (Hybrid Vigour): F1 crossbred superiority exceeding the mid-parent average due to dominance and overdominance.

u3-t18.caption: Open Nucleus Breeding System (ONBS): Gene flow between elite nucleus breeding herds and base populations.

u3-t25.caption: Breeding Management & Estrous Detection: Hormonal fluctuations (Estrogen, LH surge, Progesterone) across the estrous cycle.

u3-t27.caption: Effective Population Size (Ne) & Wildlife Dynamics: Genetic bottleneck reducing allelic diversity in small captive populations.
